# Claimball

> Claimball is a casual duel game for iOS and Android, coming soon. Bounce the ball on a notebook grid, turn tiles into your land, and beat AI rivals in quick matches of about 90 seconds.

Claimball is a casual player-versus-AI mobile game by ipe() (https://ipe.rest/). It is coming soon to iOS and Android and has NOT been released: no store page or release date exists yet. This site is the game's home and its journal. The website collects only basic visit statistics through Google Analytics and has no accounts or ads; the game app itself has no analytics SDK and no accounts. On iOS the app can save game progress to the player's own iCloud to continue on another device; it is not sent to our servers.

## Key facts

- You play against an AI rival on a notebook-style grid of 6 by 10 tiles, trading a ball back and forth.
- The tile where your ball bounces becomes your land; if you miss a return, the other side takes land from you.
- A hit in the center is a smash that claims three tiles at once.
- A match takes about 90 seconds, and the final seconds are a showdown.
- There are 6 AI rivals across 2 leagues at launch, with more planned in updates.
- Free to try. One purchase unlocks everything. No ads, no subscription.
